data.name: Glorious Presence [Enchantment]
data.description: The implement invokes the presence of those who have worn it in the past. The implement's wearer gains a +1 competence bonus on all Charisma-based skill checks and ability checks for every 2 points of mental focus invested in the implement (+%1), to a maximum bonus of +%2.|OccultistGloriousPresence|1+OccultistLVL/4
